claim_scope: two equal-shape raw action tensors can encode different units and gripper polarity
schema-aware adapters align the procedural actions while naive raw pooling changes semantics
records missing embodiment metadata are rejected before mixture construction

data.name: procedural arm_a and arm_b action records

limitations: two scalar action fields and two synthetic tasks
hand-authored invertible adapters rather than learned cross-embodiment alignment
naive pooling error is an interface counterexample, not measured negative transfer
no images, language, robot dynamics, policy training, or closed-loop evaluation
